description: Work email written Thu Mar 11, 2027 in New York. US clocks spring forward Sun Mar 14, 2027 at 02:00 EST to 03:00 EDT, so 2:30 AM that day does not exist. Saturday 7 PM is EST (UTC-5, midnight UTC on the next calendar day), Sunday 2:30 AM falls in the skipped hour and moves forward by the gap to 3:30 AM EDT, Monday 8 AM is EDT (UTC-4).
